description: This file defines the class GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO, which is part of the reporting display field components within the OrangeHRM project. It encapsulates a DateTime object and provides a method to format it as a string using helper traits.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayFieldDTO
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a date display field, providing formatted string output for a DateTime value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with an optional DateTime object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string using the helper trait.
